description: Docs drift: the docs model the list-live-inputs result as an object `{ liveInputs, range, total }`, but the live API returns `result` as a bare array of live inputs (verified 2026-10-09: GET /accounts/{account_id}/stream/live_inputs -> {"result":[{"uid":...}],"success":true}). With the object schema the array decodes to an empty struct and list() silently returns no inputs. Reshape the response into the bare-array envelope payload.

traits.smithy.api#documentation: The live inputs in the account.
